name: APPSC Group 1
pattern: Prelims: 2 objective papers × 120 questions × 120 marks, 2 hours each (screening). Mains: Telugu + English (qualifying) and 5 descriptive papers × 150 marks, 3 hours each. Interview 75 marks (check the new notification).

sections.name: Paper I: General Studies
topics: Constitution, polity, social justice and international relations
Indian and Andhra Pradesh economy and planning

sections.name: Paper II: General Aptitude
topics: General mental ability, administrative and psychological abilities
Current events of regional, national and international importance

sections.name: Paper I: General Essay
topics: Essays on current affairs and issues of regional, national and international importance

sections.name: Paper II: History, Culture and Geography of India and AP
topics: History and culture of Andhra Pradesh

sections.name: Paper III: Polity, Constitution, Governance, Law and Ethics
Paper IV: Economy and Development of India and AP
Paper V: Science, Technology and Environmental Issues
